english.title: Fail to ensure gas stunner at premises other than slaughterhouse constructed, maintained and equipped correctly
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the business operator]_
(B)_[a person]_

engaged in the stunning of poultry by exposure to gas in respect of premises, other than a slaughterhouse, used for the killing of animals, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), failed to ensure that

(C)_[the gas stunner was designed, constructed and maintained so as to avoid injury to a bird]_
(D)_[the gas stunner was equipped to maintain the gas concentration, as appropriate, in the gas stunner]_
(E)_[there was a means of visually monitoring poultry which were in the gas stunner]_
(F)_[there was a means of flushing the gas stunner with atmospheric air with the minimum of delay]_
(G)_[there was a means of access to poultry with the minimum of delay]_
(H)_[the gas stunner was equipped with devices to measure and continuously display the gas concentration, as appropriate, in the gas stunner and give clearly visible and audible warning signals if the gas concentration fell below the required level]_
(I)_[no poultry were passed through or allowed to remain in the gas stunner at any time when the visible and audible warning signals had been activated or when there was any defect in the operation of the gas stunner]_
(J)_[poultry which arrived at the gas stunner in a transport crate and which were removed from the crate before entering the gas stunner were handled with care in a way that did not cause avoidable pain, distress or suffering]_
(K)_[after exposure to gas nothing more was done to a bird until it was ascertained as dead]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(d) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 41(3) of Schedule 2 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
